class.name: SteamSocketConnectOperation
class.brief_description: A retained operation for one outgoing Steam handshake.
class.description: Await [method wait] or observe [signal completed]. The terminal result is retained for later reads.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether the operation has reached a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Returns the terminal typed result, or [code]null[/code] while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Use [code]var result: SteamSocketConnectionResult = await operation.wait()[/code]. Returns the existing result immediately or a signal that settles with the typed result.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancels the exact pending handshake and settles it with [constant ERR_SKIP]. A completed operation has no pending handshake to cancel.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once when the operation settles.
